name: Mikio Ticker Patisserie
summary: A single bakery laid out like a busy cake-shop counter: white pages, black bars and footer, cream image tiles and one cherry-red theme colour; heavy extended caps (Archivo) over Figtree, with a typewriter mono for the moving strip and stickers. A black announcement bar, a centred wordmark with a nav row, a moving ticker, a two-photo slider of the best-selling collections, rails of cream-tile cards with Add to bag, delivery photo tiles, journal features and the journal; collection pages with a two-photo hero and filters in a side panel; a product page with the collection's other pieces as tiles. Light by default, with a dark mode and a footer Theme row.
